PART III - LANDS

REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 5, 90, 122 and 125 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 830079, situated in the Village of Yodhakandiya within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 13 - Ranakeliya in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Tissamaharamaya, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of South-ern, referred to in Notice No. 83/0279 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2087/45 of 06th September, 2018 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. M. H. PRIYADHARSHANI, Commissioner of Title Settlement (Covering up Duties.) Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 10th July, 2019.
